headline: Anthropic IPO Filing Triggers Rally in Asian Tech Stocks
summary: Asian equities rose after Anthropic filed for an initial public offering, reviving artificial intelligence trade and boosting demand expectations for chipmakers.
why: Anthropic is a leading AI research company behind the Claude model, whose public listing is viewed as a major benchmark for investor sentiment in generative AI.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Anticipated compute demand from AI models supports revenue expectations for chipmakers.

why_moved: Investors bought tech and semiconductor shares following Anthropic's IPO filing, which signaled sustained capital expenditure and compute demand in AI.
